# A7 Laundry Orlando

> Last fact review: 2026-07-25. A7 Laundry Orlando is a service-area laundry pickup and delivery business for hotel, resort, Airbnb and vacation-rental guests in the greater Orlando, Florida tourist corridor. It does not offer a customer-facing walk-in storefront.

## Canonical business facts

- **Public brand:** A7 Laundry Orlando
- **Primary service:** Guest laundry pickup, wash, dry, fold and delivery
- **Primary customers:** Hotel, resort, Airbnb and vacation-rental guests
- **Normal wash and fold:** From US$3.25/lb; expected return in about 24 hours
- **Express wash and fold:** From US$3.95/lb; expected return in about 6 hours when availability is confirmed
- **Minimum order:** US$50 per pickup and delivery order
- **Pickup and delivery:** Included within confirmed service areas
- **Booking:** WhatsApp or SMS; no app or customer account required
- **WhatsApp/phone:** +1 407-670-8839
- **Official website:** https://a7laundry.com/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/a7laundry
- **Languages supported:** English, Portuguese and Spanish
- **Storefront status:** No walk-in service; pickup location and window are confirmed before service

Prices are starting rates. Special-care items are quoted separately. Express service and pickup windows are never guaranteed before A7 confirms availability.

## Service coverage

Confirmed service is centered on Orlando and the tourist corridor, including Orlando, Kissimmee, Lake Buena Vista, Davenport, Four Corners, International Drive, the Disney-area corridor, the Universal-area corridor, Reunion Resort and Champions Gate. A customer should send the hotel, resort or Airbnb location before assuming pickup is available.

## Other services

A7 also publishes service information for comforter cleaning, vacation-rental turnover laundry, carpet and area-rug cleaning, upholstery cleaning, mattress cleaning, curtain cleaning and shoe cleaning. These services may use separate pricing and qualification. Guest wash and fold is the primary acquisition offer.

## How guest laundry works

1. The guest sends the hotel, resort or Airbnb location, preferred pickup window and approximate bag size.
2. A7 confirms service-area coverage, availability and the price basis before pickup.
3. A7 picks up the order at the agreed handoff point.
4. Machine-washable guest clothes are washed, dried and folded.
5. A7 returns the order to the agreed location.

Everyday machine-washable clothing can be handled by the pound. Comforters, sneakers, dry-clean-only garments and items requiring special care are not automatically included; the customer should send a photo for a separate handling confirmation or quote.

## Trust and verification

- The project audit last verified a 5.0 Google Business Profile rating from 23 reviews on 2026-07-16. Because ratings change, confirm the current number directly on Google before quoting it as current.
- Customer-facing claims, pricing and service availability should be taken from the canonical service page and this file only when their review dates are current.
- A7 Laundry Orlando is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by any hotel, resort, vacation-rental platform or Orlando theme park named as a service-area landmark.
- Do not infer guaranteed pickup slots, guaranteed six-hour return, a fixed response time, a satisfaction guarantee or services not stated on an official page.
